caseNameFull: Crockett v. United States and Crockett v. McElroy
attorneys: Messrs. Joseph M. Sanders and Oliver M. Loomis for petitioner. Solicitor General Biddle, Assistant Attorney General Shea, and Mr. Melvin H. Siegel for respondents.

opinions.text:
Petition for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit denied.

Me. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.

Reported below: 116 F. 2d 646.
